title: Updates, upserts and bulk imports
brief: Make each change conditional and each imported conflict a domain decision.
outcomes: Use affected rows to enforce a write precondition
Stage, validate and reconcile a replayable batch
entry: Keys, constraints, transaction atomicity and the mug update.

neighbours.RL93: Owns request identity after ambiguous commit.

heading.title: A write with a precondition
heading.brief: Contrast saved stock with conditional arithmetic; require the returned row count and roll back the whole purchase on failure.

heading.title: A conflicting key
heading.brief: Distinguish insert-or-ignore, replace and merge rules; use source identity and version to prevent an old import overwriting a newer fact.

heading.title: A batch at the boundary
heading.brief: Stage valid, invalid and repeated product rows; choose all-or-nothing or documented partial acceptance and expose rejected records.

heading.title: Replay and reconciliation
heading.brief: Use stable batch IDs, counts and checksums of meaningful values; verify references, totals and checkpoints without claiming a count proves correctness.
